svg.aria-label: Simulated PWM with a sinusoidally varying duty cycle and the filtered output, a sine wave that stays between 0 and V_in
svg.text: Vary D sinusoidally and the output is a sine — riding on a DC offset

text.tspan: v_s, v_out vs. t — sinusoidal D(t); the output is a 500 Hz sine between 0 and V_in
